a.lede: Following a Ukrainian drone strike on a D.C. in Sasovo, Russia, a Yandex facility in Kaluga has suffered a similar fate with multiple modules completely out of service.
a.title: Ukrainian drones strike largest data center in Russia, multiple parts of 1.4 million square foot campus knocked offline

b.lede: One damaged data center has supercomputers used for training Yandex’s AI model.
b.title: Ukraine’s drones knock out AI data center belonging to "Russia’s Google"
